title: Network+
overview: CompTIA Network+ is the premier certification for validating your knowledge of essential networking tools and concepts. You will be assessed on your abilities in network connectivity, documentation, service configuration, data centers, cloud, virtual networking, monitoring, troubleshooting, and security hardening. This certification prepares you for jobs in technical support, network operation, and system administration. Deploy wired and wireless devices, covering IP addressing, ports, protocols, and network architecture for network deployment.
skills_measured: Review the official CompTIA exam blueprint for a detailed breakdown of skills measured.
prerequisites: Recommended experience: CompTIA A+ certification, with 9 to 12 months of hands-on experience in a junior network administrator or network support technician role
